answer: Proposed: orchard-monitoring agents need one certified chip per rewarded key for a 30-day horizon. Validators check vendor certificates and decryption of fresh challenges using each chip's nonexportable cipher key. Each chip ID may bind only one key per horizon; failed checks deny rewards. Chips are reusable capital; power recurs; no locked stake. Vendors can mint bogus IDs; rentals permit many keys per owner. At an assumed 20 tokens/chip, ten parallel keys need 200 tokens of chips; shared hosts cannot reuse IDs.
